title: Descriptive Statistics
description: Summaries, distributions, and claims that match the ink.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can compute a mean, median and a simple distribution plot, name the unit and the population the table covers, and write a chart title that is a sentence — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can discuss outliers without deleting them by default, keep summaries free of p-values and 'significant' language, and match each claim to a table or figure.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently choose a summary that matches the distribution (mean versus median, count versus rate), label axes and filters, and refuse a claim the ink does not support.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a misleading summary — a mean of a skewed set, a rate without a denominator — cite the figure that contradicts the sentence, and produce a rewrite another reader can check against the same ink.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's stats write-up, name a claim that outruns the figure, and teach when a median is the honest summary on an unfamiliar dataset.
